our_interpretation: The relevant day is February 27, 2026, using US local dates.
Public support means Altman's public endorsement of Anthropic's safety position, rather than his earlier private staff message.
Signed a deal means concluded an agreement; an announcement alone does not establish the precise execution time.
Similar terms means substantively comparable restrictions on domestic surveillance and autonomous weapons, not merely similar public statements.
Taking away business means securing the Pentagon role from which Anthropic was being excluded. It does not require proving a malicious motive.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes public support and a concluded agreement on February 27, substantively comparable safeguards, and replacement of Anthropic's Pentagon business.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence establishes different dates, materially different safeguards, or that the agreement did not replace the relevant Anthropic business.
